explication: Gemini-API is an asynchronous Python wrapper around the Gemini web app, with a CLI as an alternate entry point. The primary workflow authenticates a client, sends prompts or files to Gemini, and returns structured or streamed outputs; chat history and Deep Research add distinct conversation and plan/poll/report stages. The README also documents Gems, extensions, and generated media. Sampled source confirms authentication, chat/history, research, parsing, and media behavior; several feature implementations are represented only by their documented enclosing directory, so their internal wiring is omitted.
